This is a great and highly relevant topic in European hospitality development. Here is a comprehensive overview of the hotel brands most commonly considered by owners looking to affiliate an independent upper-upscale property through a conversion in Europe:

---

## Hotel Brands Commonly Considered for Upper-Upscale Conversions in Europe

Conversions have become a dominant growth strategy in European hospitality. 
Conversions represented around 84% of openings and 71% of signings in Europe in 2025.
 
The European hotel market is undergoing rapid franchise adoption, with brand affiliation rising from ~33% a decade ago to ~41% in 2022 — still far below the US at approximately 70%.
 Below are the main brands grouped by parent company that owners typically evaluate:

---

### 🔵 IHG Hotels & Resorts

IHG has been one of the most active players in European conversions. 
In 2024, conversions to IHG brands represented more than 80% of new openings in Europe.


- **voco Hotels** – 
Recognised as the World's Leading Premium Hotel Brand at the 2025 World Travel Awards, voco shows owners aren't just choosing speed — they're choosing performance.
 It is IHG's flagship conversion-friendly brand in the premium/upper-upscale space.

- **Vignette Collection** – 
IHG's collection brand, Vignette Collection, appeals to owners looking to convert world-class independent hotels without the need for high upfront costs or compromise on a property's unique character.
 
The brand made its debut in the UK (The Halyard, Liverpool) and in Hungary (Verno House, Budapest), both opening in 2024.


- **Noted Collection by IHG** – 
IHG's newest — and first premium collection brand — focused on upscale to upper-upscale conversions, brings together a thoughtful selection of unique properties with distinctive experiences.


---

### 🔴 Marriott International


Conversions with Marriott give owners and franchisees the opportunity to leverage the company's brands, competitive affiliation costs, revenue generation engines and Marriott Bonvoy.


- **Autograph Collection** – 
Marriott requires that Autograph Collection properties meet strict design and service standards — the property must have a distinct story, a design-forward approach, and exceptional guest experience metrics.
 
This brand targets the upper-upscale and luxury segment.


- **Tribute Portfolio** – 
Tribute Portfolio is made up of hotels for independent and spirited business and leisure travelers, defined by striking design elements, bold color, and art installations.
 
In the premium segment, Tribute Portfolio and Autograph Collection comprise more than 20% of the anticipated additions through conversion and adaptive reuse projects in Europe by end of 2026.


- **The Luxury Collection** – While positioned slightly above upper-upscale, 
Marriott's luxury segment is witnessing an increase in conversion and adaptive reuse developments, with The Luxury Collection, W Hotels, The Ritz-Carlton and St. Regis Hotels & Resorts accounting for over 10% of the expected additions by end of 2026.


---

### 🟡 Hilton

- **Curio Collection by Hilton** – 
Curio Collection hotels sit firmly in the upscale/upper-upscale segment of the hospitality market, competing directly with brands like Marriott's Autograph Collection, Hyatt's Unbound Collection, and IHG's Vignette Collection.
 
One of the selling points of Curio Collection hotels is each property's individuality — there's no standardized lobby layout, room design, or even bath amenities, giving owners the best of both worlds: worldwide scale through Hilton Honors and a boutique experience.


- **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** – 
Tapestry Collection by Hilton is a soft brand designed for unique upscale and luxury hotels
 that want to retain their identity while accessing Hilton's distribution. 
Hilton's full-service collection brands — Curio Collection by Hilton and Tapestry Collection by Hilton — continue to be active in hotel openings across Europe.


- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) partnership** – 
Hilton's 2024 partnership with Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) expanded its luxury portfolio with approximately 450 independent hotels, enhancing offerings for Hilton Honors members.


---

### 🟢 Radisson Hotel Group

Radisson has a particularly strong upper-upscale footprint in Europe. 
Radisson continues leading the upper-upscale segment in Europe in both urban and resort segments. Radisson Blu remains the largest upper-upscale brand in Europe for over a decade, alongside Radisson Collection and Radisson RED.


- **Radisson Blu** – 
Radisson Blu is an upper upscale hotel brand that delivers a positive and personalized service in stylish spaces
 and is the most prominent conversion option for full-service upper-upscale properties.

- **Radisson Individuals** – 
Radisson Individuals was set up in 2020 as a "conversion" brand allowing independent hotels to join Radisson's global platform while keeping their individual identity.
 
The expansion of the Individuals brand now includes premier, boutique, and retreats segments, with premier hotels in the upper-upscale category catering to both business and leisure guests.


---

### 🟣 Hyatt Hotels Corporation

- **Unbound Collection by Hyatt** – 
Hyatt's Unbound Collection is designed specifically for independent hotels that want brand distribution without standardizing their identity.


- **me and all hotels** – 
The me and all hotels brand combines outstanding guest satisfaction with a conversion-friendly development model in the desirable upscale lifestyle space, positioning it for scale and accelerated expansion across Europe and beyond.


---

### 🟠 Accor

- **MGallery** – Accor's MGallery brand is a boutique hotel collection targeting upper-upscale independent properties in Europe. 
Accor's brand portfolio spans over 40 brands, covering everything from budget to ultra-luxury, with a strong presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East.
 MGallery is one of Accor's key soft/collection brands for converting lifestyle-oriented upper-upscale independents.

---

### Summary Table

| Parent Company | Brand(s) for Upper-Upscale Conversions in Europe |
|---|---|
| **IHG** | voco, Vignette Collection, Noted Collection |
| **Marriott** | Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio |
| **Hilton** | Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, SLH partnership |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | Radisson Blu, Radisson Individuals (Premier) |
| **Hyatt** | Unbound Collection, me and all hotels |
| **Accor** | MGallery |


The importance of selecting the appropriate brand for a hotel resides in the impact it will have on the hotel's positioning within the market, its capacity to maximise occupancy and achieve room rate premiums, and the potential benefits of the chain's distribution channels and know-how.
 Owners typically weigh the strength of the loyalty program, the flexibility of brand standards, and the cost of the required property improvement plan (PIP) when making their affiliation decision.

content.text: The importance of selecting the appropriate brand for a hotel resides in the impact it will have on the hotel's positioning within the market, its capacity to maximise occupancy and achieve room rate premiums, and the potential benefits of the chain's distribution channels and know-how.
Owners typically weigh the strength of the loyalty program, the flexibility of brand standards, and the cost of the required property improvement plan (PIP) when making their affiliation decision.
